brief_rationale: All six responsibility-chain requirements were met without serious or minor error. The doctor correctly triaged neurologic red flags, recognized hydrocephalus urgency, avoided overinterpretation of blurry documents, clarified next owner/action/timing, prevented home medication errors, and achieved bounded safe closure with teach-back. Five dimensions are at least good. Four high-order points were completed with distinct citations not used for RC items, demonstrating beyond-minimum capability. Closure is safe, executable, and traceable. This trajectory merits grade 5 Perfect.

closure_assessment.explanation: The doctor achieved bounded safe closure by confirming family understanding of red flags (烧、漏、痛、吐、困、抽、偏), medication schedule (left-verbally confirmed steroid taper with nurse), wound care, and follow-up timing. Residual uncertainties about final pathology and tumor size are explicitly acknowledged as acceptable per case contract. Closure occurred after post-operative recovery period with family demonstrating comprehension.
